blocks.code:
activations = [x]
zs = []
for (w, b) in (weights, biases):
    z = w.T . activations[-1] + b
    zs.append(z)
    a = sigmoid(z)
    activations.append(a)
activations[-1] = softmax(zs[-1])

blocks.code:
for l from num_layers-2 to 1:
    z = zs[l-1]
    sp = sigmoid_prime(z)
    error = (self.weights[l]
             . error) * sp
    gradient_b[l-1] = error
    gradient_w[l-1] = \
        activations[l-1] . error.T

# sigmoid_prime(z) =
#   sigmoid(z)*(1-sigmoid(z))
